candidates.title: An optimized power conversion system for a stellarator-based nuclear fusion power plant (Famà et al., ECM 276, 2023)
candidates.notes: Confirmed correct paper (Famà, Loreti, Calabrò, Ubertini, Volpe, Facci). Abstract confirms Li-LiH heat source in 700–900°C temperature range; cycle efficiency 51.4% (sCO₂ topping + steam bottoming); net plant efficiency 34%. Full text requires Elsevier subscription — extraction not possible.

failed.reason: Elsevier paywall — full text requires institutional subscription. Abstract accessible but insufficient for citation; WebFetch output is lossy and cannot be used as source content.

gaps_attempted.triage_notes: No arXiv preprint found for Famà et al. (arXiv author search returned unrelated physics papers from a different Francesca Famà). No ResearchGate full text found. DOI redirect (doi.org/10.1016/j.enconman.2022.116572 → linkinghub.elsevier.com) also paywalled. The key datum — Li-LiH outlet temperature 700–900°C — appears in the abstract only and cannot be formally extracted. The Fama paper remains the only identified source for this gap.
